evidence_levels.same_dataset_validation: official SciFact Dev, unused by the published project but from the same dataset family
evidence_levels.cross_dataset: only if task semantics, evidence granularity, and retrieval corpus match without arbitrary remapping
evidence_levels.reconstructed: newly generated E1 outputs or newly fitted risk models; never represented as the historical frozen model

primary_new_evaluation.eligibility: exactly one authentic claim-level label derivable from non-empty evidence; labels must be SUPPORT or CONTRADICT; no complete-case deletion
primary_new_evaluation.unannotated_claims: exclude from error-risk metrics and retain for retrieval diagnostics only; do not map to NO_RELATION

frozen_e1.retrieval: BM25Okapi k1=1.5 b=0.75 epsilon=0.25; top 20 retrieved; top 5 to NLI
frozen_e1.selection: three label-free IDF-overlap sentences per selected document

e1_v2_candidate.rationale: Apache-2.0 NLI cross-encoder with a stronger DeBERTa-v3 encoder; not scientific-domain trained
e1_v2_candidate.retrieval_selection_aggregation: identical to E1 so the NLI substitution is isolated
e1_v2_candidate.selection_rule: no test-set model selection; report regardless of direction

learner.continuous_standardization: fit-population mean and population standard deviation; zero variance scale=1
learner.categorical_encoding: F3 uses SUPPORT reference, plus is_CONTRADICT and is_NO_RELATION

metrics.ranking: ascending predicted error risk; ties by SHA-256 of 20261015:claim_id
metrics.aurc: arithmetic mean of prefix selective risks for k=1..n
metrics.paired_differences: candidate minus B1; negative is better for AURC and R80

post_hoc_historical.prohibition: no model or feature selection on the used Internal Test

perturbations.name: inject_irrelevant_top5_document
perturbations.strength: one deterministic corpus document selected by claim hash

perturbations.name: bm25_score_jitter
perturbations.strength: deterministic plus/minus five percent without changing retrieved content

metrics: expected calibration error with 10 equal-width bins

decision_rule: All point estimates and uncertainty intervals are reported; no post-hoc success threshold is introduced. The historical H1 remains INCONCLUSIVE.
